text:
maria: Quick schema QA + internal-link priority matrix for the launch + webinar. Need eyes before EOD. Main asks: canonical targets, redirect checklist, keyword mapping for launch post + benchmark narrative. TL;DR below.

jonathan: Can you paste the matrix? cc content team.

maria: dropping a simple CSV matrix for visibility — feel free to copy into the sheet and add columns you need.

```
path,priority,canonical_target,keyword_intent,notes
/blog/launch-llm-benchmarks,1,/blog/launch-llm-benchmarks,commercial - "llm inference benchmarks",primary launch narrative, canonical to blog
/docs/benchmarks,2,/blog/launch-llm-benchmarks,informational - "inference latency comparison",add rel=canonical to blog and cross-link from blog
/webinar/register,1,/webinar/register,transactional - "redwood inference webinar",Event schema + register CTA markup
/blog/benchmarks-appendix,3,/blog/launch-llm-benchmarks,informational - "methodology",link from blog, noindex? NO - keep indexed
/blog/launch-llm-benchmarks/summary,2,/blog/launch-llm-benchmarks,commercial - "benchmarks summary",merge if duplicate content
```

alex: Can we add a redirect_source column? I can put together 301 mappings once we finalize canonical targets.

seo_lead: Suggest add 'schema_required' and 'query_examples' columns. Webinar needs Event + FAQ schema for SERP features.

maria: good call — I updated the live sheet (https://tiny.redwood/sheet123). Proposed assignments: alex -> redirects, chris -> canonical checks + crawl, jonathan -> content FAQ + keyword lines, seo_lead -> keyword intent mapping.

ops-bot: Reminder: deployment freeze 22:00 - 02:00 PST tonight (from infra).

chris: I'll run a Screaming Frog crawl and a link-graph export. If a page has >50 internal inbound links, treat it as priority 1 for preserving anchor text and redirect mapping.

jonathan: small nit: only use rel=canonical when pages are true duplicates. For short variant pages, prefer consolidating content into the canonical target rather than aggressive canonicalization.

alex: :thumbsup: I'll add redirect_source + http_status columns to the sheet and start a 301 mapping doc.

seo_lead: For webinar schema: include startDate, endDate, location (online), offers.price (if any), and use FAQ schema for the top questions in the registration flow. Also add OpenGraph for the webinar and set twitter:card to summary_large_image.

maria: plan: wrap up matrix by 4pm, open a PR to content repo with meta/canonical header changes, then hand off redirect list to infra for staged 301s after deploy window. I'll ping again at 16:00. :rocket: \/cc @alex @chris @jonathan @seo_lead

ops-bot: Deploy bot: scheduled maintenance tonight 23:30 PST - expect minor console downtime (info).

jonathan: ack, thanks everyone.
